_comment: Registry of swappable real photos. Drop a file into public/images/store/<key>.webp and it replaces the CSS placeholder automatically on the next build. Keep the listed dimensions.
_products_comment: Expected product photos (owner-supplied). Each entry points to the exact file the app looks for at build time: if the file is present in public/images/products/, the product image is wired automatically (catalog tiles, product page gallery, structured data); while the file is missing, the «Фото уточняется у менеджера» placeholder stays. Spec per file: WebP (AVIF optional), portrait 4:5, 1600×2000 px, device centered with even margins, transparent or uniform #F7F7F9 background, no text, no watermark, ≤ 300 KB. Run `npm run images:check` to see which files are present, `npm run images:prepare -- <input-file> <slug>` to prep a dropped photo. See docs/ADDING-PRODUCT-PHOTOS.md.
